newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs trickle towards holidays.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs trickle towards holidays.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds should remain steady with a bullish undertone for the rest of this year as many players have already closed their books and have their eyes set on 1997.
"Many traders and institutionals have already closed their books," Kredietbank financial analyst Koen Dierckx told Reuters.
At 1500 GMT, the benchmark 2006 OLO was yielding 5.91 percent, against 5.92 at the close on Friday, after having touched 5.90 in early business.
The 10-year OLO/Bund yield spread was expected to remain steady at 10 to 11 basis points until next year.
